name: @careeros/desktop
description: CareerOS is a desktop career workspace for managing resumes, jobs, interview preparation, coding practice, and AI-assisted application workflows.

scripts.dist: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:latex && npm run prepare:oauth && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:latex:win && npm run prepare:oauth && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis zip --publish never && npm run verify:latex:bundle:win
scripts.dist:win:local: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:latex:win && npm run prepare:oauth && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis zip --publish never --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && npm run verify:latex:bundle:win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:latex && npm run prepare:oauth && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm pacman --publish never
scripts.dist:flatpak:dir: npm run build:web && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.flatpak.yml --linux dir --publish never

linux.synopsis: Career workspace for resumes, jobs, interviews, and applications.
linux.description: CareerOS is a desktop career workspace for managing resumes, jobs, interview preparation, coding practice, and AI-assisted application workflows.
